name: scapular-wall-slide
instructions:
1. Setup in a standing position with feet away from the wall and your lower back, hands, and elbows touching the wall.
2. Exhale and slide your hands up the wall while maintaining a neutral spine position until the elbows are completely locked out.
3. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
